start.title: [TODO:it] Your Servant
start.text:
[TODO:it] Your servant lies dying.
You hear a teacher is near.

doctor_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Seek the Healer
doctor_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] No skill of Rome can save him.
Only Jesus can.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Do Not Delay
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Mercy passes through your town.
Reach him now.

seek.title: [TODO:it] Before the Teacher
seek.text:
[TODO:it] You stand before him.
A Roman among his people.

agree.title: [TODO:it] "I Will Come"
agree.text:
[TODO:it] "I will come and heal him."
He steps toward your home.

proud_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Look Within
proud_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Who are you that he should come?
Speak the truth.

faith.title: [TODO:it] Only Say the Word
faith.text:
[TODO:it] "I am not worthy."
What will you ask?

hurry_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Trust His Word
hurry_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] His word alone is enough.
Speak it.

sign_consequence.title: [TODO:it] No Proof Needed
sign_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Faith does not bargain.
Speak from belief.

praise.title: [TODO:it] Such Great Faith
praise.text:
[TODO:it] He turns to the crowd amazed.
"I have not seen such faith."

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Stay Humble
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The glory is not yours.
Bow quietly.

heal.title: [TODO:it] Healed From Afar
heal.text:
[TODO:it] You return home.
Your servant breathes deep, well.
